summary_insights: The company maintains a healthy liquidity position with a current and quick ratio of 1.75, indicating sufficient cover for short-term obligations.
Cash reserves are robust at £52,209, representing over 56% of total current assets.
The asset base is light on fixed assets (£250), reflecting a service-based business model with minimal capital expenditure requirements.
Net assets stand at £33,096, though this is impacted by a significant current year loss of £76,496 which has eroded the opening retained earnings.
Long-term leverage is low with a gearing ratio of 19.7%, primarily consisting of a remaining Bounce Back Loan balance.
Corporation tax of £41,386 represents the largest single current liability, which will require careful cash flow management when due for payment.
The balance sheet shows a net current asset position of £39,365, providing a reasonable buffer for operational volatility.
